title: CLAUDE.md
text: zudate R package implements TC39 Temporal date/time model (Instant, PlainDate, PlainTime, PlainDateTime, ZonedDateTime, Duration, …) top Rust crate jiff, vendored package builds offline CRAN. R <-> Rust bridge savvy. Read design.md (architecture, data model, API mapping, CRAN constraints) roadmap.md (milestones 0.1.0) adding features. Keep files current design decision changes.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: R commands run package root. devtools, testthat, roxygen2, rcmdcheck, lintr, styler pkgdown expected installed. savvy-cli installed cargo install savvy-cli --locked. Order operations touching Rust: edit src/rust/src/*.rs -> savvy-cli update . -> devtools::document() -> devtools::load_all() / devtools::test(). Forgetting savvy-cli update leaves init.c/api.h/000-wrappers.R stale produces “object ’savvy_…_impl’ found” link errors. Forgetting document() leaves NAMESPACE without useDynLib, gives “object found” error even though compilation succeeded.
code: # Regenerate the FFI glue after ANY change to #[savvy] items in src/rust/src/*.rs savvy-cli update .            # rewrites src/init.c, src/rust/api.h, R/000-wrappers.R  # Regenerate NAMESPACE and man/ (roxygen comments live in R/*.R, including the generated wrappers) Rscript -e 'devtools::document()'  # Compile the Rust crate + shared object and load the package into a session Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all()'          # DEBUG=true -> cargo dev profile (pkgbuild sets it)  # R-side tests (testthat, edition 3) Rscript -e 'devtools::test()' Rscript -e 'devtools::test(filter = "instant")'     # single file: tests/testthat/test-instant.R Rscript -e 'testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-instant.R")'  # Rust-only unit tests (no R session; #[cfg(test)] modules) cargo test --manifest-path src/rust/Cargo.toml  # Rust tests that need a live R session (#[cfg(feature = "savvy-test")] modules) savvy-cli test src/rust  # Full check as CRAN sees it (what CI runs) Rscript -e 'rcmdcheck::rcmdcheck(args = c("--no-manual", "--as-cran"), error_on = "warning")'  # Rust lint / format cargo fmt --manifest-path src/rust/Cargo.toml cargo clippy --manifest-path src/rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets  # R lint / format Rscript -e 'lintr::lint_package()' Rscript -e 'styler::style_pkg()'  # Docs site Rscript -e 'pkgdown::build_site()'

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: zudate brings TC39 Temporal date/time model R. date/time logic delegated Rust crate jiff (0.2.x), designed Temporal implements semantics (RFC 9557 strings, nanosecond precision, time-zone-aware arithmetic, disambiguation rules, rounding modes, calendar-aware spans). R code provides vectorised, R-idiomatic types interop base R; Rust arithmetic. document records architecture decisions behind . roadmap.md tracks delivery.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: Goals 0.1.0 Faithful Temporal semantics core types: Instant, PlainDate, PlainTime, PlainDateTime, ZonedDateTime, Duration, plus Now. Vectorised R classes behave like ordinary R vectors: length(), [, c(), rev(), sort(), unique(), .na(), data-frame columns, saveRDS() round trip. Nanosecond precision without floating-point drift. Round-trip conversion Date, POSIXct, POSIXlt, difftime. Builds offline CRAN tarball Linux, macOS (x86_64, arm64) Windows (Rtools, x86_64; arm64 best effort), honouring CRAN Rust policy. Non-goals 0.1.0 (see roadmap “0.1.0”) Non-ISO calendars. jiff implements ISO 8601 (proleptic Gregorian) calendar, calendar arguments accepted "iso8601". PlainYearMonth, PlainMonthDay. jiff types; can layered civil::Date later. Locale-aware formatting (toLocaleString). jiff offers strftime, enough 0.1.0. User-defined custom time zones beyond IANA identifiers fixed offsets.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: Three rules keep simple: Rust stateless. Every #[savvy] function receives whole columns (R vectors), loops elements, builds jiff values fly, returns whole columns. jiff object outlives call. external pointers public API, values serialise, copy subset like R vector. R owns vector semantics. Length, recycling, NA, names, subsetting, concatenation, printing data-frame integration implemented via vctrs (new_rcrd), Rust. Temporal defines behaviour, jiff implements . two differ, jiff wins difference documented file (section 9). Otherwise R code adapts call user-visible result matches Temporal specification.
code: R user code   |  vctrs record vectors (plain R vectors: double/integer/character)   v R/*.R            constructors, S3/vctrs methods, argument normalisation, option objects   |  .Call() through generated R/000-wrappers.R   v src/init.c       generated by savvy-cli; .Call registration + error trampoline   |  C ABI (SEXP in, SEXP out)   v src/rust/src/    hand-written Rust: #[savvy] fns, columnar in/out, per-element jiff calls   |   v vendored jiff    all date/time semantics, tzdb lookup, parsing, formatting, rounding

what: Why savvy (not extendr or cpp11 + a C++ date library)
title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: savvy generates full .Call boilerplate R wrappers, small dependency footprint (savvy, savvy-ffi, savvy-macro, cc, proc-macro crates), panics converted R errors rather crashing R. small footprint matters every transitive crate vendored CRAN tarball. jiff mature Rust library whose data model Temporal’s; implementing Temporal chrono Howard Hinnant’s date mean reimplementing disambiguation, span rounding RFC 9557 parsing hand.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: Temporal type S3 class built vctrs::new_rcrd(). Fields ordinary atomic vectors; NA field marks missing element. Field order chosen vctrs’ default record ordering (lexicographic fields) equals Temporal’s compare(). Notes seconds double jiff::Timestamp spans roughly years -9999..9999, .e. ±3e11 seconds, well inside 2^53 exactly-representable range. Rust validates integrality. ZonedDateTime stores time zone identifier per element, Temporal . jiff resolves identifier call; Rust keeps per-call HashMap<&str, TimeZone> column one distinct zone pays one lookup. Duration field ranges jiff::Span (years ±19998, months/weeks/days i32-ish, time units i64). Construction validates uniform-sign rule ranges Rust errors Temporal error wording. Temporal’s Instant JavaScript BigInt epoch nanoseconds; expose epoch_nanoseconds() character/bit64-free double pair helper accessors (epoch_seconds(), epoch_milliseconds(), epoch_nanoseconds() returning string) since R native 64-bit integer. records rather single numeric attributes (like POSIXct): single double hold nanosecond instants exactly, splitting two integer-valued fields keeps every value exact staying copy--modify friendly.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: Naming: snake_case, one constructor per type, generic verbs prefixed type Temporal method. functions vectorised recycle arguments vctrs::vec_recycle_common(). NA propagates element-wise never errors.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: Every character constructor parser; as_instant(), as_plain_date(), etc. S3 generics methods character, base R classes zudate classes.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: temporal_fields(x) returns data frame fields. Individual accessors: year(), month(), day(), hour(), minute(), second(), millisecond(), microsecond(), nanosecond(), day_of_week(), day_of_year(), week_of_year(), year_of_week(), days_in_month(), days_in_year(), in_leap_year(), epoch_seconds(), epoch_milliseconds(), offset(), offset_nanoseconds(), time_zone(), hours_in_day(), total()/abs()/sign()/blank() durations. implemented R record fields trivial, Rust otherwise.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: Operators provided vctrs::vec_arith() Instant + Duration, Duration + Instant, PlainDate - PlainDate (returns Duration days, Temporal’s since default units) ZonedDateTime - Duration dispatch correctly errors undefined combinations use Temporal error text.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: to_instant(), to_zoned_date_time(x, time_zone, disambiguation =, offset =), to_plain_date(), to_plain_time(), to_plain_date_time(). ZonedDateTime -> Instant exact; Instant -> ZonedDateTime needs time zone; Plain* -> Zoned* goes disambiguation.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: format(x, ...) / .character(x) implement toString() Temporal’s options: fractional_second_digits = "auto", smallest_unit, rounding_mode, offset = "auto"|"never", time_zone_name = "auto"|"never"|"critical", calendar_name = "auto"|"always"|"never"|"critical". temporal_strftime(x, fmt) temporal_strptime(string, fmt, class) expose jiff::fmt::strtime. print() shows Temporal string form; pillar methods make tibble columns readable.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: Default time zone: Temporal’s Now uses system zone. use R’s Sys.timezone() (honours TZ) rather jiff’s system detection results match base R inside session.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: Every option string argument validated R rlang::arg_match() mapped jiff enum Rust. Temporal spelling used verbatim (camelCase strings) documentation can copied Temporal docs.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: Rust entry points return savvy::Result. jiff::Error converted message (e.g. "parameter 'day' value 31 required range 1..=30"); R wrapper rethrows condition class zudate_error element index appended ("... (element 3)") vector operation fails. Temporal distinguishes RangeError TypeError. R conditions carry subclass zudate_range_error / zudate_type_error; input-type problems detected R calling Rust. NA never error. Rust receives NA R’s sentinel values via savvy’s is_na() emits NA fields output. Panics must impossible user input. panic = "abort" stays release builds (CRAN requirement package leave R corrupted state Rust unwind), unwrap()/indexing user-controlled data bug.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: CRAN policy Rust (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/using_rust.html) binding constraint build. scheme: Vendored sources. cargo vendor runs src/rust/Cargo.lock result stored compressed src/rust/vendor.tar.xz (git, regenerated tools/vendor.sh, also refreshes inst/AUTHORS). src/Makevars.extracts src/rust/vendor/ cargo build writes .cargo/config.toml src/rust/ redirects crates-io directory; cargo runs --offline. cleanup removes extracted directory generated config. Lockfile committed. src/rust/Cargo.lock tracked builds reproducible vendored set matches exactly. Cargo.toml pins jiff savvy explicit minor versions ("*"). Dependency surface. Keep minimal every crate’s source ships tarball counts toward 5 MB CRAN size guideline. Expected set: jiff, jiff-core, jiff-tzdb-platform + jiff-tzdb (used Windows vendored every platform), windows-link (Windows), portable-atomic/portable-atomic-util (target-conditional, pulled cargo vendor), savvy, savvy-ffi, savvy-macro, proc-macro2, quote, syn, unicode-ident, cc, shlex. Measured .crate sizes (gzip): jiff 0.67 MB, syn 0.31 MB, jiff-core 0.13 MB, cc 0.10 MB, savvy 0.06 MB, jiff-tzdb 0.06 MB; xz-compressed vendor tarball land around 2 MB. Features jiff: std, tz-system, tz-fat, tzdb-zoneinfo (read /usr/share/zoneinfo Unix), tzdb-bundle-platform (bundled database platform none, .e. Windows), perf-inline; default-features = false drops tzdb-concatenated (Android ), serde, logging jiff-static. Time zone database. Linux/macOS jiff reads /usr/share/zoneinfo (TZDIR). Windows uses bundled jiff-tzdb Windows zoneinfo. CRAN’s check machines satisfy one . ZUDATE_TZDIR honoured override testing. Document package database version therefore follows OS Unix vendored crate Windows. Authorship licences. DESCRIPTION adds person("authors dependency Rust crates", role = "cph"), inst/AUTHORS lists every vendored crate authors licence, LICENSE.note summarises licence mix (MIT, Apache-2.0, Unlicense jiff). permissive compatible package’s MIT licence. Build constraints. cargo build -j 2 (CRAN limits two cores), --offline, network, writes outside build directory (CARGO_HOME pointed inside src/rust/ build cargo never touches ~/.cargo), cargo/rustc versions echoed configure (already place), SystemRequirements: Cargo (Rust's package manager), rustc (>= 1.xx) real MSRV, Rust edition 2021 (edition 2024 needs rustc 1.85, older CRAN flavours may ). Windows ARM64. configure.win currently hardcodes x86_64-pc-windows-gnu. Choose target R_ARCH/uname -m aarch64-pc-windows-gnullvm builds ARM64 Rtools. Installed size. static library deleted linking (already done); release profile sets opt-level = 3, lto = true, codegen-units = 1, strip = true. Package checks. Zero R CMD check ---cran warnings; tolerated NOTE one installed libs size appears. Tests examples run well minute. webR/Emscripten support savvy template kept promised.

Expectations taken Temporal documentation examples selected cases test262 Temporal suite (ported hand testthat; script tools/ records origin). Every option value every documented error message test. Property tests Rust (#[cfg(test)]): parse/format round trips, add since identity, ordering consistency across record representation jiff comparison. savvy integration tests (savvy-cli test) anything needs live R session, e.g. NA handling FFI boundary. Platform matrix via existing CI (pedrobtz/r-actions rust: true): Linux, macOS, Windows; full-ci label push main runs full set. Add job installs built tarball network disabled prove vendored build works. CRAN rehearsal: rhub::rhub_check() Rust-enabled images devtools::check_win_devel() submission.

title: zudate design (target: 0.1.0 on CRAN)
text: Per-call cost one .Call plus allocation per output column; per-element cost jiff operation (tens nanoseconds civil math, hundred zoned math zone cached). competitive clock far faster lubridate vector work. Parsing character vectors done Rust; R never splits strings. ZonedDateTime columns many distinct zones pay one TimeZone::get per distinct id per call. parallelism Rust (CRAN restricts two threads jiff work already cheap).
